stats.title: State of the country
stats.body: The six figures in the upper-left corner are your briefing. Hover or focus any one to see units and risk thresholds; click it to open the related section.

books.title: Management sections
books.body: The icons open economy, industry, technology, population, politics, and other books. Click an active icon to close it; keys 1–9 are shortcuts.

llm.title: Turn status
llm.body: Turn events are authored by the LLM. This indicator shows whether its response is ready; click it to open the LLM cycle and apply the response.

orders.title: Your orders
orders.body: Describe your political intent in free text and add it to the turn. It guides the LLM narrative; it does not bypass the simulation rules.

turn.title: Next month
turn.body: Once the LLM response is applied and your orders are ready, press Next turn. The simulation advances one month; you can replay this briefing from the ? button in the header.
